newsitem.title: USA: Dow holds above 8,000, Nasdaq extends rally.
newsitem.headline: Dow holds above 8,000, Nasdaq extends rally.

text.p: The Dow industrials backed off from highs in afternoon trade on Wednesday but did not break below the 8,000 record level crossed earlier as the technology sector marched upwards.
The Dow Jones Industrial average, which rose despite sharp declines in component Eastman Kodak following below-forecast earnings results, was up 32 points at 8008.
The Nasdaq composite, whose technology stocks led the charge higher, gained 27 points, or 1.73 percent, to 1569.
The long bond lent support, as the benchmark 30-year Treasury touched a 6.48 percent yield, up 26/32.
